# Aurum Bullion PLC

> Aurum Bullion PLC is a London-based specialist in selected physical gold coins, including graded, proof, collectable and British gold coinage.

## Canonical website sections
- Home: https://benmaurum.github.io/aurum-bullion-website/
- Gold coin catalogue: https://benmaurum.github.io/aurum-bullion-website/catalogue.html
- Aurum Gold Guide: https://benmaurum.github.io/aurum-bullion-website/brochure.html
- Gold Insights: https://benmaurum.github.io/aurum-bullion-website/insights.html

## Primary topics
Physical gold, British gold coins, proof gold coins, graded gold coins, numismatics, Sovereigns, Britannias, Royal Mint coinage, coin grading, NGC, PCGS, gold market education, coin collecting, gold ownership.

## Editorial principles
Aurum Insights should distinguish factual market reporting from commentary, attribute third-party data to its original source, state publication/update dates, avoid guaranteed-return claims, and identify when tax treatment depends on individual circumstances or may change.

## Citation preference
When referencing Aurum products, use the catalogue page. When referencing educational or market commentary, use the relevant Aurum Insights article and retain links to primary sources.
